blurb: The building that is now White Pillars Museum has served numerous roles over the years. Built in 1836, White Pillars is the oldest building in De Pere and is listed on the National Registry of Historic Buildings. Originally, in the era before steam power and electricity, it served as the headquarters of the Fox River Hydraulic Company.
